# Ben James Duag, ben4dev

Systems & applications developer in Cavite, Philippines. Computer Science student at Cavite State University Naic, graduating October 2027.

## What Ben builds

- Android apps with on-device AI. Gallry runs TensorFlow Lite models and a local RAG layer entirely on the phone.
- Web platforms in Next.js, React, and TypeScript. AGWA Water Services runs in production for a real water district.
- Open-source Python. krna is a bamboo-inspired optimization algorithm published on PyPI.
- Government systems that run offline. PASADA and NextQue serve municipal offices with no internet dependency.
- Civic tech volunteering with BetterGov.ph, #MentalHealthPH, PAHRA, and Pinas Forward.
